# Deal Lifecycle State Chart

> Generated from `FUNNEL_TRANSITIONS` + `FUNNEL_TRANSITION_TRIGGERS` (Layer 1) and
> `SUBSCRIPTION_TRANSITIONS` + `SUBSCRIPTION_TRANSITION_TRIGGERS` (Layer 2) in

## Layer 1 — Visitor Sales Funnel

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> new_session
    new_session --> privacy_acknowledged : privacy.acknowledged
    privacy_acknowledged --> intent_selected : intent.selected
    intent_selected --> organization_selected : organization.selected
    intent_selected --> change_balance_checked : change.requested
    organization_selected --> qualification_priority : qualification.answered
    qualification_priority --> qualification_company : qualification.answered
    qualification_company --> qualification_service : qualification.answered
    qualification_service --> qualification_region : qualification.answered
    qualification_region --> offer_presented : qualification.answered
    offer_presented --> payment_pending : offer.selected
    payment_pending --> payment_confirmed : payment.confirmed
    payment_confirmed --> start_choice_pending : system.advance
    start_choice_pending --> start_deferred : start.choice.selected
    start_choice_pending --> buyer_type_pending : start.choice.selected
    start_deferred --> buyer_type_pending : start.choice.selected
    buyer_type_pending --> b2b_start_consent_pending : buyer.type.selected
    buyer_type_pending --> b2c_withdrawal_consent_pending : buyer.type.selected
    b2b_start_consent_pending --> start_approved : legal.consent.recorded
    b2c_withdrawal_consent_pending --> start_approved : legal.consent.recorded
    start_approved --> legal_data_requested : system.advance
    legal_data_requested --> materials_requested : material.submitted
    materials_requested --> production_ready : material.submitted
    production_ready --> operator_review : operator.note.added
    production_ready --> won : operator.won
    change_balance_checked --> change_payment_pending : payment.link.requested
    change_balance_checked --> change_description_requested : system.advance
    change_payment_pending --> change_description_requested : payment.confirmed
    change_description_requested --> operator_review : change.requested
    change_description_requested --> production_ready : system.advance
    change_description_requested --> won : operator.won
    operator_review --> won : operator.won
    operator_review --> lost : operator.lost
    operator_review --> production_ready : system.advance
    won --> [*]
    lost --> [*]
    note right of lost
        All non-terminal stages reach lost via system.timeout (abandon).
        The 23 timeout edges are recorded in FUNNEL_TRANSITION_TRIGGERS and
        verified by funnel.statechart.validate — omitted here for legibility.
    end note
```
